Grammar · Theory

Past simple · affirmative & negative

📘 Thì quá khứ đơn — kể việc đã xảy ra và đã kết thúc (động từ có quy tắc · bất quy tắc · was / were · didn’t)
subjectbe / auxverbkey word
✅ Regular verbs
subject+verb + -ed+…
Động từ có quy tắc: thêm -ed
We cooked dinner at home.
She played tennis on Sunday.
⚡ Irregular verbs
go → went·see → saw·buy → bought
Động từ bất quy tắc: học thuộc dạng quá khứ
I saw a good film on Friday.
He bought a new phone yesterday.
➖ Negative
subject+didn't+base verb+…
didn't + động từ nguyên mẫu (mọi chủ ngữ)
I didn't watch TV last night.
They didn't go out on Sunday.
🧍 was / were
I / He / She / It+was / wasn't
You / We / They+were / weren't
Quá khứ của be: I / he / she / it → was · you / we / they → were
The weather was hot.
We weren't at home yesterday.
💡 RememberMột dạng cho mọi chủ ngữ: I / she / they cookedSau didn't → động từ nguyên mẫu: ✅ didn't go ❌ didn't wentKhông dùng didn’t với be: ❌ I didn’t be ✅ I wasn’t

A1 → A2 Communication Accelerator · S1009
Structure 1 / 4

Last weekend, I ___.

🇻🇳 Cuối tuần trước, tôi đã ___.
→ Really? That sounds fun!
🇻🇳 Thật à? Nghe vui đấy!
QHow was your weekend?
💬 Common answers
a
Last weekend, I visited a local market.Cuối tuần trước, tôi đã đi chợ địa phương.
b
Last weekend, I attended a weekend event in the park.Cuối tuần trước, tôi đã tham dự một sự kiện ở công viên.
c
Last weekend, I stayed at home. I didn't go out.Cuối tuần trước, tôi ở nhà. Tôi đã không ra ngoài.
⚡ Translate now · Dịch ngay
1🇻🇳 Cuối tuần trước, tôi đã về quê.
🇬🇧 Last weekend, I returned to my hometown.
2🇻🇳 Cuối tuần trước, tôi đã gặp anh họ của tôi.
🇬🇧 Last weekend, I met my cousin.
3🇻🇳 Cuối tuần trước, tôi đã không đi làm.
🇬🇧 Last weekend, I didn't go to work.
→ / Space / presenter
A1 → A2 Communication Accelerator · S1010
Structure 2 / 4

I had a chance to ___.

🇻🇳 Tôi đã có cơ hội ___.
→ Wow! How was it?
🇻🇳 Ồ! Nó thế nào?
QDid you do anything special?
💬 Common answers
a
I had a chance to try some local food.Tôi đã có cơ hội thử đồ ăn địa phương.
b
I had a chance to visit a local market.Tôi đã có cơ hội ghé thăm chợ địa phương.
c
I had a chance to stay overnight on a boat.Tôi đã có cơ hội ngủ qua đêm trên thuyền.
⚡ Translate now · Dịch ngay
1🇻🇳 Tôi đã có cơ hội tham dự một sự kiện lớn.
🇬🇧 I had a chance to attend a big event.
2🇻🇳 Tôi đã có cơ hội gặp bạn cũ.
🇬🇧 I had a chance to meet my old friends.
3🇻🇳 Tôi đã có cơ hội chụp nhiều ảnh.
🇬🇧 I had a chance to take lots of photos.
→ / Space / presenter
A1 → A2 Communication Accelerator · S1011
Structure 3 / 4

The best part was ___.

🇻🇳 Phần hay nhất là ___.
→ That sounds great!
🇻🇳 Nghe tuyệt quá!
QWhat was the best part?
💬 Common answers
a
The best part was the night market.Phần hay nhất là chợ đêm.
b
The best part was the food.Phần hay nhất là đồ ăn.
c
The best part was the weekend event.Phần hay nhất là sự kiện cuối tuần.
⚡ Translate now · Dịch ngay
1🇻🇳 Phần hay nhất là bãi biển.
🇬🇧 The best part was the beach.
2🇻🇳 Phần hay nhất là gặp gia đình tôi.
🇬🇧 The best part was meeting my family.
3🇻🇳 Đó là một chuyến đi đáng nhớ.
🇬🇧 It was a memorable trip.
→ / Space / presenter
A1 → A2 Communication Accelerator · S1012
Structure 4 / 4

I was ___, but it was worth it.

🇻🇳 Tôi đã ___, nhưng nó rất xứng đáng.
→ I am happy for you!
🇻🇳 Tôi mừng cho bạn!
QYou look tired!
💬 Common answers
a
I was exhausted, but it was worth it.Tôi đã kiệt sức, nhưng rất xứng đáng.
b
I was tired, but it was worth it.Tôi đã mệt, nhưng rất xứng đáng.
c
I was very busy, but it was worth it.Tôi đã rất bận, nhưng rất xứng đáng.
⚡ Translate now · Dịch ngay
1🇻🇳 Tôi đã kiệt sức, nhưng nó rất xứng đáng.
🇬🇧 I was exhausted, but it was worth it.
2🇻🇳 Tôi đã rất mệt, nhưng tôi thích trải nghiệm đó.
🇬🇧 I was very tired, but I enjoyed the experience.
3🇻🇳 Chúng tôi trở về nhà lúc nửa đêm.
🇬🇧 We returned home at midnight.
→ / Space / presenter

Pronunciation

-ed endings — /t/ · /d/ · /ɪd/

/t/after p, k, s, sh, ch, fwalked · booked · missed · watched
/d/after voiced sounds & vowelsstayed · enjoyed · returned · played
/ɪd/after t and dvisited · attended · waited · needed
💡 Only /ɪd/ adds a new syllable: vis-i-ted · at-ten-ded.
walked = /wɔːkt/ (1 syllable!)
walked
stayed
visited
enjoyed
booked
attended
returned
missed
waited
watched
played
needed

Speaking · Game

Two truths and a lie — No, you didn't…!

🎲Topic: last weekend
1Speaker: say 3 sentences about the topic — 2 true, 1 false.
Last weekend, I visited a local market. I stayed overnight at my friend's house. I didn't eat any street food.
2Listeners: find the lie!
I think you didn't stay overnight at your friend's house!
3Speaker: Yes, that's the lie! / No — I really stayed there! I was exhausted, but it was worth it.
1:00
➖ Negative: didn't + verb
❌ I didn't went ✅ I didn't go
